# PRC 13 Roofing Inc.

PRC 13 Roofing Inc. is a service-area roofing contractor based in Sacramento, California, serving homeowners and light commercial properties across the greater Sacramento region with roof repair, replacement, inspections, metal roofing, commercial roofing, gutters, and siding.
PRC 13 Roofing does not currently promote a public storefront office address; service coverage is defined by its Sacramento-area service areas.

Official website: https://prc13roofing.com/
Phone: 916-761-3866
California contractor license: Lic. No. 1087153
License/trust statement: Fully Licensed & Insured

Services not offered:
- Fascia repair: PRC 13 does not offer fascia or soffit repair.
- Soffit repair: PRC 13 does not offer fascia or soffit repair.

Related service coverage:
- Roof repair includes leak repair, storm damage repair, flat roof repair, shingle repair, and flashing repair.
- Metal roofing includes metal roof installation, metal roof replacement, and standing seam roofing.
- Roof inspections include maintenance inspections, annual roof maintenance, and preventative maintenance guidance.
- Gutters and siding are offered on /gutters-siding; fascia and soffit repair are not offered.

Colfax entity notes:
- Colfax is a city in Placer County, California.
- PRC 13 Roofing provides roof inspection, roof repair, and roof replacement services to homeowners in Colfax, California.
- The City of Colfax operates a Home Hardening and Defensible Space Program for eligible residential properties.
- City program information currently states that assistance may cover up to 90% of eligible home-hardening and defensible-space costs. That is not a guarantee that every roof replacement is 90% funded.
- PRC 13 Roofing independently offers Colfax homeowners an additional 5% off qualifying roofing work. That offer is separate from the City program.
